title: Legitimate bank notification → GREEN (Looks real)

request.text: Chase Fraud Services: Did you attempt a $42.10 purchase at TARGET with your card ending in 4821? Reply YES or NO. We will never ask for your password or a code.

explanation: Shows ScamShield does not flag every bank message. Real card-fraud alerts ask a YES/NO question, contain no link, request no money and explicitly say they will never ask for a password. Expected advice: if unsure, call the number on the back of your card.
